The 95 adapter scenarios move from one mixed TestCase to eight direct native behavior classes: metadata11, actual archive14, mapped resources3, clean installation11, portability15, generation19, diagnostics5, public contracts17. The supported test-adapter-distribution.py entrypoint only collects those classes. Ordinary adapter fixture functions expose input paths, fresh copies, generated setup and metadata; the injected clean-install runner explicitly performs the real installation before the case-supplied missing/stale resource mutation. Generic installed-fixture guards retain failure rather than recovering into success; scenario assertions remain in the tests. No TestCase setup borrowing, added inheritance, mutable global fixture, custom runner or production packaging behavior is introduced.
Retain all archive and resource observations: independent recursive canonical filesystem membership for both actual target ZIPs, raw bytes for unchanged resources, declared Claude entrypoint transforms, complete Verify/route resources, generated structure validated independently, exact layer/hash drift, missing archives/resources, stale hashes and archive-target mismatch. The boundary resource matrix exercises every declared consumer/resource on both targets through generation, real archives and actual clean installs; complete canonical inventory independently protects against producer-domain omissions. Narrower production inventories serve setup/observed-value roles, not sole proof of full emitted resource membership. Supported target/retired gate and published invocation domains also retain separate expected target literals and independently traversed canonical skill names.
Retain output containment including source/active-root overlap, siblings, symlinks and real install preservation. Clean-install cases retain non-installing runner rejection, missing/stale/unowned installed resources for both targets, canonical/portable/requested selection, unknown/duplicate/mixed CLI selection and preflight ordering. Metadata/manifest groups retain current default identity, malformed/missing values, unknown profile before reads, required/optional combined artifacts, real archive checksums/source mismatch, literal YAML quoting and target transforms. Portability retains each meaningful named lexical/Unicode/HTML/Markdown invocation partition and per-variant fresh source copy; defining changed input and expected inclusion/reason remain visible. Historical/retired target wording in these inputs protects current lexical classification and denial; it does not re-enable the retired installer. Generated drift, missing/extra/malformed canonical input, forbidden metadata/security and deterministic bounded/verbose diagnostics remain distinct outcomes. Public guidance/workflow/static checks remain scoped structural proof of current repository consumers, including present tracked support documents and absence of generated committed bodies; this test-only initiative does not claim adoption of a separate future source-cleanup behavior.
Correct the author-discovered real-CLI diagnostic ownership defect m5-log-isolation within the three groups that launch installed CLI children (archive/resources/install). Each native case calls an ordinary configure_adapter_case function that acquires a private temporary log root, immediately registers deletion, then registers restoration of its scoped environment patch. Other test groups already own their mutable roots and do not launch log-writing installed commands. Logging remains enabled and real; no product default logging behavior is changed. Normal direct and isolated per-case entrypoints both acquire their own roots. The stand-in caller directory is preserved, and cleanup touches only the allocated private resource.
All16 recursive adapter input files remain byte-identical. Their separate roles are valid generic source, target-specific capability/install/tool/invocation exclusions, explicit alternatives, frontmatter transforms, invalid name/description/body, and one copied transitive asset. Existing Skill and real release consumers still reach these shared fixture/package boundaries. No fixture or meaningful variant was dropped.
Retain seven npm policy/artifact/output scenarios and expose the previously hidden explicit-plus-primary recording sequence as one new independently selectable case. That ordered integration intentionally creates the example store before the primary status observation reads it. Both codex and claude contexts still use actual freshly packed/installed binaries and actual local-archive target installation before recording, with separate private projects. All73 original recording statements and their assert/operation order are preserved, apart from an explicit project cwd for the interrupted child. Exact schema/template bytes, real subject hashing and target-record writes, conflict/no-write behavior, busy concurrent writer, interrupted persistence, restore/complete recovery, retired/unknown-store rejection and target-field projection remain observed at the packed public boundary. The smoke case retains real help/version/init/removed-state flags and packaged workflow-command execution; observability retains actual log events, output modes and documentation agreement. Native cleanup attaches immediately after npm/log resource acquisition. Operation helpers only perform declared command/packing/setup mechanics; former assertion-named operation sequences no longer hide the scenario.
Strengthen actual tarball expectations with an independent literal20-member runtime/trust/schema/template inventory under Packaging DIST-SR-23. The inspector's production required set no longer supplies its own expected result or the required-member basis of forbidden-path fixtures. Actual current candidate metadata remains separately asserted; forbidden path/policy and genuine packed binary installation remain independent observations. A controlled omission probe removes command-result.js from a real freshly packed tarball while reducing the production inspector list: old focused test passes, new expectation fails at the intended missing-member assertion without setup errors. This proves the focused oracle is stronger; it does not claim the entire old suite would have missed an unusable package.
All current adapter subset selectors and their independent expected commands were reconciled. The three command/adapter and coverage fingerprints bind the changed exact selectors; check IDs, prerequisites, native adapters and worker constraints remain unchanged. Eleven new module paths select their exact existing owner checks; an unknown packaging path still blocks. Full native discovery preserves95 mapped adapter identities plus seven original npm identities and one extracted scenario; the fourteen-case adapter subset discovers its exact intended names once. No new framework, permanent per-case registry or line-count rule is added.

checks.summary:
C1 ordinary discover_cases before/after matches the explicit95-class-selector map, preserves all seven npm selectors and adds one named packed recording case. AST comparison preserves all95 adapter test methods after normalization of explicit fixture calls; it also preserves all73 ordered recording statements with only declared child cwd normalization. The exact14-case supported adapter subset discovers all supplied selectors exactly once. C1 collection does not substitute for execution.
Full direct python tests/engineering/packaging/test-adapter-distribution.py passes95; python tests/engineering/packaging/test-npm-package-publication.py passes8 with real npm tarballs, actual installed binaries, both target archives/installations and actual recording/recovery. Actual-file C2 python scripts/select-validation.py --mode explicit and bash scripts/ci.sh --mode explicit --jobs4 cover every changed engineering/record path and pass all selected checks, including selected adapter/native package/npm/selector/executor consumers. Normal direct and isolated selected cases use privately owned mutable fixtures.
New-path regression initially reports11 unclassified variants and passes after exact catalog registration. The real tarball omission experiment passes the old focused oracle and fails the new one as intended, zero errors. Initial full execution exposed a function/local-variable fixture-name collision (six variants) and stale command fingerprints; the first selected CI correctly refused stale adapter basis before work. Rename the ordinary path helper to fixture_path and reconcile all three command and coverage identities; two focused regressions then pass, followed by the complete rerun. Original failing logs are preserved in scratch and this summary, not presented as passes. A temporary indentation error during explicit-cwd editing was caught immediately by parsing and fixed before final proof. No failing required result or unresolved protection is waived.
An additional ownership probe found the existing real adapter installation case passed while creating one diagnostic file in a private stand-in caller state directory. This observation and blocker origin were recorded before correction. It was then refined into a strict automated no-caller-write regression, also recorded before correction: identical actual-case command, fixture, repository cwd and logging environment, no stage-dependent success predicate; exit1 before correction and exit0 afterward, caller files1 then0. Probe identity is retained in m5-log-isolation-regression and matches the post-fix script bytes. Original reporter resolves the blocker only on this exact proof and the final full adapter/selected CI reruns; npm suite source is unchanged since its passing full8-case run. Prior passing pre-fix adapter/CI logs are kept separately and do not establish current ownership success.
Final diff checking found extra terminal blank lines in eight extracted modules; remove them and verify identical parsed ASTs. All executed behavioral source is unchanged; only terminal whitespace differs. Current record structure/reference validation and staged diff checks accompany the commit. Reusable earlier unaffected milestone evidence remains exact-scope historical evidence; changed catalog/selector subjects require independent M5 interaction review and later fresh whole-change review. No public release/hosted success, final broad-smoke result or Verify readiness is claimed by this milestone.
